text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of a long and
arduous
journey in the Twinkle Series for
me and my
trainee. Her name is...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're in the presence of Sweep
Tosho—also
known as the genius
Magical Girl Sweepy!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Listen up. Someday, I'm going to
become a great
witch just like Grandma!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But for that to happen, I'll need you to
work reeeal hard for me as my familiar!
You can start
off by bringing me some
sweets!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begin my days challenging the
Twinkle
Series with
<chrname>!
